title: A finite union of Noetherian subspaces is Noetherian
statement: Let $T$ be a topological space, let $I$ be a finite set, and let $T_i\subseteq T$ for $i\in I$. Suppose that each $T_i$, with its subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology], is Noetherian, meaning that every descending chain of closed subsets stabilizes. Then $\bigcup_{i\in I}T_i$, with its subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology], is Noetherian.
